failure_reason: POLICY BLOCK, not a technical block: amazon.ae's robots.txt (https://www.amazon.ae/robots.txt, direct fetch HTTP 200, re-verified 2026-09-02) contains FOUR separate directives that specifically and by name disallow Anthropic/Claude crawlers with a full-site 'Disallow: /': 'User-agent: ClaudeBot' (listed twice, lines 111 and 198), 'User-agent: Claude-User' (line 195), 'User-agent: Claude-SearchBot' (line 201), and 'User-agent: Claude-Web' (line 258) - all four 'Disallow: /'. This is distinct from and far more restrictive than the generic 'User-agent: *' group (lines 1-88), which only disallows a specific list of account/cart/review/wishlist/signin utility paths and otherwise permits crawling. Per the brief's explicit instruction to check robots.txt for a Claude-specific disallow, and this project's established precedent of respecting such directives rather than routing around them (S.N. 113 Home24 DE, S.N. 159 home24 Germany, El Corte Ingles, and this company's own prior Home-Decor pass archive c189 which stopped for the same reason), no category/qty extraction was attempted. No WAF-bypass technique, Playwright/CDP rendering, or Claude-in-Chrome use was applied once the robots.txt finding was reconfirmed. The site itself is live (robots.txt served HTTP 200, prior pass's homepage fetch got HTTP 202 with an AWS WAF JS-challenge interstitial, confirming the domain is active) - this is purely a deliberate policy stop, not a claim of technical unreachability.
notes: Read notes/285.md first: prior Home-Decor pass (archive c189) also stopped at the robots.txt check before any extraction, for the identical robots.txt finding. Re-fetched https://www.amazon.ae/robots.txt directly (curl_cffi-style desktop UA, not identifying as Claude) to confirm the directive is still current as of 2026-09-02 - it is unchanged: ClaudeBot (x2), Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-Web all carry 'Disallow: /' as named, separate blocks distinct from the generic '*' group. No category tree, Pet Supplies browse-node structure, or qty data was extracted - the assignment's suggestion to check for a real Pet Supplies browse-node taxonomy (vs. raw search) was never reached because extraction did not begin, per the robots.txt policy-block rule which takes priority over the access-tier ladder. Flagging for orchestrator: Noon UAE (S.N. 191), also a marketplace in this roster, was already flagged by the prior pass for the same robots.txt check; any other UAE/GCC marketplace company not yet checked should get the same robots.txt verification before extraction.
